title: [3.0-beta1] Incorrect COB
symptom: After entering a food bolus of 35g carbs, the COB (Carbs on Board) shows 60g instead of the expected value. The issue is observed in Overview, Treatments, and Loop screens.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but a maintainer indicates it was fixed by a specific commit, implying a bug in the code.
fix: The issue was fixed by commit 345a57da09453c4528a470f669e192d048fddc18.
